report.answer_text:
The five compulsory daily prayers in Islam, known as salah, are:
| Prayer | Time | Obligatory units (*rak‘ahs*) |
|---|---|---:|
| Fajr | Dawn, before sunrise | 2 |
| Dhuhr | Just after solar noon | 4 |
| Asr | Afternoon | 4 |
| Maghrib | Just after sunset | 3 |
| Isha | Night, after twilight has faded | 4 |
The counts are for the obligatory portion of each prayer.
